_comment: Design manifest (config: design.manifest). Copy into the project, fill in the file keys and frames. design_library.py reads design_source; ui-design-compare reads frames through the library build's frame maps.

design_source._note: Figma file keys: the library file holds the published components and styles, the screens file holds the drawn screens.

attachments._note: Optional: docs-page images design_assets.py downloads. mode newest = the latest attachment of each listed page; all = every attachment of one page, named <prefix>-NN.
